attr.title: Shogun Showdown
attr.desc: A turn-based roguelike where every move counts. Fight through waves of enemies on a single row of tiles, plan around each foe's attack timer, collect and upgrade attack tiles, and face the Shogun.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and use the Steam console to download the Linux build: `download_depot 2084000 2084002 5092188064288801929`. Copy everything from the download (`ShogunShowdown.x86_64`, `UnityPlayer.so` and the `ShogunShowdown_Data` folder) into `ports/shogunshowdown/gamedata/`. The first start adapts the game files to the device, which takes about a minute.
